issues.display_title: Issue #47: feat(db): migrate CockroachDB to dual-table schema (action_documents & knowledge_documents)
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Align CockroachDB schema to support identical, parallel action_documents and knowledge_documents tables. API contracts are moved from the separate action_contracts table directly into a contracts JSONB column on both tables.

Requirements

  • Define action_documents table with columns matching knowledge_documents + contracts JSONB + embedding VECTOR(1536).
  • Add contracts JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB to knowledge_documents.
  • Implement automated, idempotent SQL migration to copy existing action documents and aggregate their contracts from action_contracts into action_documents without data loss.
  • Drop legacy action_contracts table after migration verification.
  • Update app/db/connection.py:init_db to run DDL and migration idempotently on startup.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Both action_documents and knowledge_documents exist with identical column structures.
  • Existing 48 action documents and their 86 contracts in local CockroachDB are preserved in action_documents.
  • Unit tests in tests/db/test_connection.py pass.

Result

  • Implementation Status: Completed via Commit a867ccc and included in Pull Request #50.
  • Changes Applied:
    • Defined symmetrical action_documents table schema matching knowledge_documents, including contracts JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB and vector cosine distance index.
    • Added contracts JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB column to knowledge_documents via ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS.
    • Implemented automated, idempotent migration routine in app/db/connection.py:init_db:
      • Automatically transfers existing action documents (doc_type = 'action') from knowledge_documents to action_documents.
      • Aggregates associated contracts from legacy action_contracts into inline JSONB arrays stored directly in action_documents.contracts.
      • Cleans up legacy foreign keys and drops action_contracts table after verification.
  • Verification & Acceptance:
    • Verified on local CockroachDB: 48 action documents and all 86 associated contracts successfully preserved in action_documents.
    • Symmetrical schemas confirmed across both tables.
    • Tests in tests/db/test_connection.py pass with zero regressions.

issues.display_title: Issue #48: feat(retrieval): implement tiered search and inline contracts in CockroachRepository
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Update CockroachRepository to support inline contracts JSONB document reconstruction and implement tiered retrieval prioritizing action_documents with automatic fallback to knowledge_documents.

Requirements

  • Reconstruct KnowledgeDocument directly from row["contracts"] JSONB instead of joining action_contracts.
  • Update upsert_document to route to action_documents when doc_type == "action" and serialize action_contracts to JSONB.
  • Implement tiered vector search in search_similar_documents:
    1. Primary: Search action_documents using cosine_distance(embedding, $query_vector).
    2. Fallback: If results are insufficient or empty, query knowledge_documents to fill remaining limit.
  • Update document CRUD helper methods (get_document_by_slug, delete_document_by_slug, count_documents, load_all_documents) to support the dual-table model.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Documents retrieved from action_documents contain their action_contracts parsed from JSONB.
  • Action searches prioritize action_documents first, falling back to knowledge_documents if necessary.
  • Unit and integration tests in tests/db/test_repository.py and tests/db/test_retriever_db.py pass.

Result

  • Implementation Status: Completed via Commit d71e23e and included in Pull Request #50.
  • Changes Applied:
    • Reconstructed KnowledgeDocument directly from row["contracts"] JSONB using Pydantic validation, eliminating legacy relational JOIN overhead on action_contracts.
    • Updated upsert_document to route by doc_type: serializes and writes contracts to action_documents when doc_type == "action", and stores general knowledge in knowledge_documents.
    • Implemented tiered vector search in search_similar_documents():
      1. First queries action_documents for dense matches.
      2. If candidate count is less than limit, queries knowledge_documents for the remainder (remaining = limit - len(results)) without duplicate document IDs.
    • Unified repository CRUD operations (get_document_by_slug, delete_document_by_slug, count_documents, load_all_documents, list_documents) across both tables.
  • Verification & Acceptance:
    • Verified deserialization of action contracts from JSONB during retrieval.
    • Verified tiered search ordering: action documents prioritized first, followed by knowledge fallback.
    • Unit and integration tests in tests/db/test_repository.py and tests/db/test_retriever_db.py pass cleanly.

issues.display_title: Issue #49: feat(ingestion): update admin upload and seed scripts for dual-table routing
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Ensure document ingestion channels (admin upload endpoints and CLI seed scripts) route files to the correct target tables (action_documents vs knowledge_documents) and verify end-to-end operation on local CockroachDB.

Requirements

  • Update scripts/seed_cockroach.py to route markdown files from actions/ to action_documents and from base-knowledge/ to knowledge_documents.
  • Update app/api/routes_admin.py (/actions, /actions/batch) so uploaded action documents sync specifically to action_documents.
  • Execute migration and verify zero data loss on local Docker CockroachDB (localhost:26257).
  • Verify full test suite passes.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Uploading an action file via admin API writes to action_documents.
  • Seeding base-knowledge writes to knowledge_documents.
  • Local verification shows 48 action_documents and 39 knowledge_documents with vectors intact.
  • All test suites pass.

Result

  • Implementation Status: Completed via Commits 1dba37a & 7770d53 and included in Pull Request #50.
  • Changes Applied:
    • Updated scripts/seed_cockroach.py to route files from actions/ with doc_type="action" (targeting action_documents) and files from base-knowledge/ with doc_type="knowledge" (targeting knowledge_documents).
    • Standardized routes_admin.py single and batch upload handlers to target action_documents.
    • Added robust boolean parsing helper _parse_overwrite_form_value in app/api/routes_admin.py to handle multipart form boolean values seamlessly across clients.
  • Verification & Acceptance:
    • Ingestion routing verified: admin uploads persist to action_documents while seed script populates both tables according to document origin.
    • Local CockroachDB verified: 48 action_documents (with 86 parsed contracts) and 39 knowledge_documents stored with valid vector embeddings.
    • Complete test suite passes: 256 passed, 0 failed across all test files.

issues.display_title: Issue #51: feat(ingestion): add in-memory markdown parser for action documents
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Add an in-memory markdown parser (parse_action_document) in app/ingestion/action_loader.py to extract document metadata, execution contracts, user intents, context, and UI flow directly from a raw Markdown string without requiring disk files or temporary staging directories.

Ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-22-full-database-runtime-design.md

Requirements

  • Add parse_action_document(raw_text: str, document_id: str, source_file: str | None = None) -> KnowledgeDocument.
  • Extract YAML frontmatter/blocks, action contracts, operations, purpose, intents, required context, preconditions, and step-by-step UI flow purely in-memory.
  • Refactor load_action_documents to reuse parse_action_document for disk scanning in CLI tools (preserving backward compatibility).
  • Add comprehensive unit tests in tests/ingestion/test_action_loader.py.

Execution Results

  • Implemented parse_action_document in app/ingestion/action_loader.py to parse markdown content directly into KnowledgeDocument without touching the filesystem.
  • Refactored load_action_documents to delegate to parse_action_document while preserving offline fixture loading.
  • Added comprehensive unit tests in tests/ingestion/test_action_loader.py validating metadata extraction, contracts, and UI flow parsing.
  • Implemented in PR #54 (commit 5a17684). Verified with 100% passing tests.

issues.display_title: Issue #52: feat(runtime): initialize in-memory retriever from CockroachDB and enforce strict DB mode
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Make CockroachDB the exclusive source of truth at application startup by loading documents directly into memory to build the BM25 index and initialize ActionRetriever, while deprecating storage/rag/actions.json and enforcing strict fail-fast if the database is unconfigured or unreachable.

Ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-22-full-database-runtime-design.md

Requirements

  • Add strict_db_mode: bool = False in app/core/config.py (enforced when strict_db_mode is True or app_environment == "production").
  • Remove module-level disk loading (load_action_documents(Path(settings.actions_dir))) and _indexer.rebuild() from app/api/routes_chat.py.
  • Add init_runtime_catalog_from_db() and refresh_runtime_catalog() in app/api/routes_chat.py to query CockroachRepository.load_all_documents() and rebuild the in-memory BM25 index and ActionRetriever.
  • Update FastAPI lifespan in app/main.py to verify connection and call init_runtime_catalog_from_db().
  • Raise RuntimeError and log critical error if database is unconfigured or unreachable in strict/production mode.
  • Eliminate dependency on storage/rag/actions.json cache file.
  • Add lifecycle tests in tests/test_health.py and tests/api/test_chat_routes.py.

Execution Results

  • Added strict_db_mode: bool = False configuration in app/core/config.py enforced in production environments.
  • Removed module-level disk loading and eliminated dependencies on storage/rag/actions.json.
  • Implemented init_runtime_catalog_from_db() and refresh_runtime_catalog() in app/api/routes_chat.py to query CockroachDB and initialize in-memory BM25 index and ActionRetriever.
  • Updated application startup lifecycle in app/main.py to verify CockroachDB connectivity and populate runtime state with fail-fast behavior.
  • Added test coverage in tests/test_health.py validating strict DB startup failure and success conditions.
  • Implemented in PR #54 (commit 0015555). Verified with live CockroachDB container and full test suite passing.

issues.display_title: Issue #53: feat(api): make admin action upload, delete, and listing 100% database-backed
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Eliminate all disk I/O, temporary staging folders, and disk rollback routines from admin endpoints (/actions, /actions/batch, /actions/{slug}). Process uploads in-memory, persist directly to CockroachDB, and trigger atomic in-memory retriever refreshes.

Ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-22-full-database-runtime-design.md

Requirements

  • Refactor POST /actions to parse uploaded Markdown in-memory via parse_action_document, validate retrievability in memory, check overwrite in DB, upsert to action_documents, and call refresh_runtime_catalog() with zero disk writes.
  • Refactor POST /actions/batch to parse all files in-memory, validate, batch upsert to CockroachDB, and trigger a single refresh_runtime_catalog().
  • Refactor DELETE /actions/{slug} to delete directly from CockroachDB and refresh in-memory retriever (returning HTTP 404 if slug not found).
  • Update GET /actions and GET /actions/{slug} to strictly query CockroachDB (repo.list_documents(), repo.get_document_by_slug()) without reading local disk directories.
  • Verify full test suite passes (256+ tests) and test E2E against local Docker CockroachDB.

Execution Results

  • Refactored POST /actions and POST /actions/batch in app/api/routes_admin.py to process uploads purely in-memory, upsert directly to CockroachDB, and trigger atomic retriever refresh without filesystem I/O.
  • Refactored DELETE /actions/{slug} to delete directly from CockroachDB and refresh the runtime index.
  • Updated GET /actions and GET /actions/{slug} to query CockroachDB exclusively when configured.
  • Upgraded POST /ingest/actions for selective vector backfill (all=false/all=true) directly in CockroachDB.
  • Verified zero disk writes, tested against live Docker CockroachDB container, and verified 270 passed tests.
  • Implemented in PR #54 (commits 0015555, 2753eec, 2104484, 5de7233).

issues.display_title: Issue #56: feat(routes): define universal navigable route registry and metadata
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Define the data structures and central registry for all navigable routes across the GoThru dashboard in app/copilot/routes.py, establishing a single source of truth for navigation actions.

Requirements

  • Introduce NavigableRoute dataclass containing:
    • feature: str
    • path_template: str
    • label: str
    • slugs: tuple[str, ...]
    • intent_pattern: re.Pattern[str]
    • required_params: tuple[str, ...] (e.g. tour_id, pano_id, tour_key, user_id)
  • Register all 21 global static routes (Home, My Tours, Storage, Token, CRM, Agency Hub, Photographer Directory, Notification, Portfolio routes, and Profile/Account routes).
  • Register all 16 tour-scoped sub-workspaces (upload, edit, hosted, publish, auto-stitching, editor, nadir, sequence, blur, placeId, etc.).
  • Register 3 sub-parameter routes (edit/{pano_id}, hosted/templates/{tour_key}, agency/{user_id}).
  • Explicitly exclude /support (Support Tickets) from the navigable registry.
  • Add find_navigable_route(query: str) -> NavigableRoute | None helper to match slash command slugs and natural language intent patterns.
  • Add unit tests in tests/copilot/test_routes.py.

Acceptance Criteria

  • All valid dashboard routes (except /support) can be resolved to a NavigableRoute.
  • Any query targeting /support or support tickets returns None.
  • Unit tests pass.

Execution Results

  • Implemented NavigableRoute dataclass in app/copilot/routes.py with feature, path_template, label, slugs, intent_pattern, and required_params.
  • Defined central registry NAVIGABLE_ROUTES containing 42 dashboard routes (21 global static, 16 tour-scoped, 3 sub-parameter).
  • Explicitly excluded /support (Support Tickets) via SUPPORT_EXCLUSION_PATTERN.
  • Added helper function find_navigable_route(query) matching slash slugs and natural language queries, returning None for support inquiries.
  • Added unit tests in tests/copilot/test_routes.py verifying coverage and exclusion.
  • Implemented in PR #59 (commit 903db16).

issues.display_title: Issue #57: feat(planner): implement registry-driven navigation engine in CopilotPlanner
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Refactor CopilotPlanner navigation logic to dynamically resolve client navigation actions using find_navigable_route from the central route registry, supporting parameter extraction and validations.

Requirements

  • Update _detect_client_action in app/copilot/planner.py:
    • Check for support queries and ensure no client navigation action is created.
    • Preserve precedence of high-priority tool modal actions (archive, transfer, download, tag, delete) and on-page actions (trigger_file_picker on /upload, add_level_modal on /edit).
    • Query find_navigable_route for incoming message/query.
    • Enforce required parameter validation:
      • Missing tour_id: return needs_context ("Please specify or mention which tour you would like to navigate to.")
      • Missing pano_id: return needs_context ("Please specify the panorama ID (pano_id) to view this panorama's information.")
      • Missing tour_key: return needs_context ("Please specify the template key (tour_key) to view this hosted template match.")
      • Missing user_id: return needs_context ("Please specify the user ID (user_id) to view this agency sub-user's workspace.")
    • Dynamically check is_already_there against the active browser route. If already on the target route, return answer_only with no navigation action.
    • Emit ClientActionEvent(action="navigate", target=target_url, label=route.label, auto_trigger=is_explicit, params=params) when parameters are satisfied.
  • Unify slash command /navigate handling across plan() and aplan().
  • Update app/copilot/answerer.py clarification passthroughs if necessary.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Any registered route can be navigated to via natural language or /navigate <slug>.
  • Missing required parameters return appropriate needs_context clarification.
  • Redundant navigation on current page returns answer_only.
  • Support route queries never produce a navigate client action.

Execution Results

  • Refactored _detect_client_action in app/copilot/planner.py using find_navigable_route for dynamic route matching.
  • Enforced strict support exclusion (SUPPORT_EXCLUSION_PATTERN), preventing navigation action generation for support inquiries.
  • Implemented parameter validation and needs_context returns for missing tour_id, pano_id, tour_key, and user_id.
  • Implemented dynamic redundancy checks (is_already_there), returning answer_only when user is already on the target page.
  • Preserved priority on-page actions (browse_files on /upload, add_level_modal on /edit, tour tools, create_tour_menu).
  • Unified slash command /navigate processing in plan() and aplan() via _resolve_slash_navigate_plan.
  • Updated app/copilot/answerer.py to pass parameter clarification prompts directly without LLM latency.
  • Implemented in PR #59 (commit a018d03).

issues.display_title: Issue #60: feat(copilot): add upload client actions for Google Drive, Dropbox, and Auto Stitching
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Currently, RAG Copilot client action for panorama upload only supports generic file browsing (trigger_file_picker with target="browse_files"). When users ask to upload via Google Drive, Dropbox, or Auto Stitching, the system either navigates without tab preservation or falls back to standard file browsing.

This issue tracks adding dedicated intent detection and client action dispatching for Google Drive, Dropbox, and Auto Stitching.

Proposed Changes

  • Intent Regex (app/copilot/planner.py):
    • Add _GOOGLE_DRIVE_UPLOAD_PATTERN
    • Add _DROPBOX_UPLOAD_PATTERN
    • Add _AUTO_STITCHING_UPLOAD_PATTERN
  • Planner Dispatch (_detect_client_action in app/copilot/planner.py):
    • Out-of-page (user inside a tour or mentions tour ID):
      • Google Drive: action="navigate", target="/my-tours/{tour_id}/upload?page=google_drive", label="Google Drive Upload"
      • Dropbox: action="navigate", target="/my-tours/{tour_id}/upload?page=dropbox", label="Dropbox Upload"
      • Auto Stitching: action="navigate", target="/my-tours/{tour_id}/upload?page=stitching", label="Auto Stitching"
    • In-page (user already on /my-tours/{tour_id}/upload):
      • Google Drive: action="trigger_gdrive_picker", target="google_drive", auto_trigger=False
      • Dropbox: action="trigger_dropbox_chooser", target="dropbox", auto_trigger=False
      • Auto Stitching: action="trigger_stitching_picker", target="stitching", auto_trigger=False
    • Outside tour (no tour ID): return None (clarification required).
  • Unit Tests (tests/copilot/test_planner.py):
    • Add test cases covering Condition A (inside tour, out-of-page), Condition B (outside tour), and Condition C (in-page) for each upload method.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Queries mentioning Google Drive, Dropbox, and Auto Stitching generate the expected client_action payload.
  • Existing generic browse file upload flow remains unaffected.
  • Exclusions (archive/delete intents mentioning drive/dropbox) do not trigger upload actions.
  • All unit tests pass in .venv/bin/pytest tests/copilot/test_planner.py.
